nodes.title: Upload a NEW fictional group image

widgets_values: Original hand-inked 2D cel-animated late 1990s arcade fighting game. Use the supplied image as the exact first frame. Exactly the same six fictional fighters stand together in their original positions in the same invented backyard. Preserve every fighter face, skin color, hair, clothing, complete silhouette, hands and body proportions. No extra people or body parts. Keep the camera at the original wide group framing throughout, all six in frame. Retain the warm lamps and hand-drawn ink, restrained charcoal, ivory, brick red and blue palette. No words, logos, UI, subtitles, borders, watermark, scene cuts, photorealism, or camera flash. This is a short cinematic opening for the game. Over eight seconds the group subtly prepares for a friendly tournament: one hero raises a guarded fist, another shifts into a stance, and the others make small confident head and shoulder movements. A very slow gentle camera push-in emphasizes the group without cropping any fighter. Physical actions are grounded and understated; every hand stays attached to its arm, no large movement, no combat, no energy explosions or transformations. Preserve identities and outfits all the way to the end.
